examples.name: layering.js

exercise.prompt: Assign code to its layer: "res.status(201).json(order)" (controller), "if (order.total < 0) throw" (service), "INSERT INTO orders" (repository), "validate req.body with schema" (controller boundary).
hints: Rules in services; SQL in repositories; schema validation at the boundary.

questions.prompt: The point of thin controllers is…
options: transport logic separate from rules, so services are testable without HTTP
questions.explanation: Services testable with plain unit tests are the payoff.

questions.prompt: SQL belongs in repositories so that…
options: storage can change and services stay unaffected
questions.explanation: The repo is the storage port; services depend on the interface, not SQL strings.
